=== yaml-demo
policy (Charter): yaml-demo
source:  yaml-demo.yaml

host.type           k8s
host.image          alpine:3.20
host.workdir        /workspace
host.runtime_class  gvisor

[prompt]
  inline: You are careful. …

[env]
  PLAIN  = hello       (literal)
  TOKEN  = «redacted»  (1password)

[network]
  default: deny (allowlist below)
  allow api.example.com
  allow *.githubusercontent.com
  allow api.example.com

[policy] engine: builtin
  shell  rm -rf*  -> deny
  shell  *        -> allow

[budgets and limits / rationing]
  wall_clock: 1h30m
  max_execs: 50
  loop: 3 within 60s

[cohort]
  replicas: 2
  tasks: 2 seeded

[signed audit / chronicle]
  redact: false
  sink: /var/log/ledger.jsonl
=== json-demo
policy (Charter): json-demo
source:  json-demo.json

host.type     container
host.image    python:3.12
host.workdir  /workspace

[files]
  /etc/motd (mode 0444)

[network]
  default: allow (OPEN — no egress restriction)

[policy] engine: cel
  tool == "shell" && arg.startsWith("rm")  -> deny
  true                                     -> allow

[ide]
  enabled: true
  port: 8080
  path: /
  agents: claude, codex

[signed audit / chronicle]
  redact: true
